Pope Leo on Sunday, September 28, prayed for the victims of devastating typhoon that struck several Asian territories during his weekly Angelus prayer at St. Peter's Square.

"I pray for the victims, the missing, the many displaced families, the countless people who have suffered hardship, and also for the rescuers and civil authorities," the pontiff said.

Vietnam closed airports and evacuated thousands of people in potentially effected areas on Sunday as intensifying Typhoon Bualoi (locally known as #OpongPH) barrelled towards the country, days after causing at least 10 deaths and widespread flooding in the Philippines. | via Reuters

Video courtesy: Vatican Media via Reuters

quoted_tweet.text:
Ahoy! 🏴‍☠️ 🏴‍☠️

You have likely seen the $STRAWHAT flag on your feed at this point. You perhaps realise it’s viral, but are curious as to why.

How is this such a monumental narrative you ask? 

One Piece is a global monolith of a series, with the Guiness World Record for as the best-selling manga of all time with over 500 million copies sold since its debut in 1997. It has aired 1145 episodes now, and even has a live-action Netflix adaptation so successful that a 2nd season is being filmed. 

In One Piece, our hero and captain, Monkey D. Luffy, a young pirate sails the seas alongside his closest friends, the $STRAWHAT pirates. The crew sail the Grand Line, and along their epic adventure touch the lives of many they encounter. The Strawhat Pirates fight against oppressive powers and free countless nations and individuals, going so far as to burn the flag of the abusive and corrupt World Government in their headquarters, to save just one friend. This starts a global war, which the Strawhats rise up to, unafraid.

How did the $STRAWHAT flag become a real symbol of protest? In early August, Indonesian protests were rife due to dissatisfaction with the reigning government. On Independence Day, instead of flying the Indonesian flag, truck drivers organised to fly the One Piece flag in protest of a law that unfairly affected their wages. 

An innocent, unaffiliated driver was run over and killed by a police vehicle as the authorities reprimanded protesters, which further incited rage and a desire for justice by drivers, and citizens. Strawhat jolly rogers were soon seen at every protest, outside houses, on walls, and vehicles all over the country. It was to the point where the Indonesian government declared that flying the flag was a punishable offence, and treason.
https://t.co/CZIxqQbt3m 

During this time $STRAWHAT launched on bonk, reaching an ATH of 375k. As the narrative was considered temporary, it was abandoned, sold and left in the dust… until…

Early September, generation Z took to the streets of Nepal, having had enough of the government’s corrupt displays of wealth, mismanagement of public funds, and lack of economic opportunities for the poor/young. Inspired by our hero Luffy, Gen Z protestors stormed Singha Durbar (the Prime Minister’s office and ministries) and set it ablaze. Front and centre to this, was the $STRAWHAT flag which protestors flew, and marked on the palace’s golden gates
https://t.co/CQCfULlfOY 

We launched $STRAWHAT on pump, re-igniting the community, reaching an ATH of 444k. Again, CT thought this was temporary, however core believers still held… until…

20th September – the flag was raised AGAIN in the Philippines. In one of the largest protests in the country’s history, protesters gathered at Manilla’s Luneta Park voicing frustration against government officials siphoning off funds for much-needed flood relief projects. The flag was on full display, in the crowd, on stages, and plastered on walls. 

https://t.co/13OPy9YxnV 
$STRAWHAT token surged back up to 125k....

The virality of this phenomenon has continued, with protestors globally standing up against their governments, much like the Strawhat pirates. At this stage the flag has been raised additionally in France, Italy, Madagascar, Rome, New York, Japan, Kenya, Serbia and even Germany.

Major news outlets have felt compelled to comment on this “Symbol of liberation”, including WSJ, NBC, CNN, CBC, The Guardian, and The Washington post:
https://t.co/1I8enUCvwQ 

https://t.co/7jXMQb55hN 

https://t.co/bm80WeWF2p

https://t.co/wNmIoORB7p

https://t.co/qbIKP5MUZf 

https://t.co/KuTCY6jyGz 

Social media is noticing it too with tiktok videos racking up 100s of thousands of views, and major influencers posting: 
https://t.co/lSsuaNJEgd

https://t.co/ux8zSqHscK 

https://t.co/APACXBP8DG 

The $STRAWHAT flag continues to get noticed and pick up traction and at this point it is undeniable that what One Piece has built in the story, resonates globally and inspires global action with the Gen Z youth. 

Even now, MAJOR protests against President Boluarte and clashes with the police are taking place in Peru to stand up for the elderly affected by new pension reforms. In these protests, our flag takes centre stage.

$STRAWHAT is the new symbol for liberty, of opportunity for all, and for standing up for the little man.
